findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the maintenance window and the LINK_LOS alarm, but does not explicitly state that the work caused the sites to go offline as scheduled.
The cited alert ALR-0032 explicitly lists the drop in traffic, active users, and availability on S-SFX-008 and two other sites for 2 hours.
The cited maintenance record MW-0005 confirms the window, node, work type, and exact times 01:57 to 04:15.
The cited alarms show LINK_LOS (02:00-04:08) and SITE_DOWN (02:01-04:09) occurring within the maintenance window (01:57-04:15).
The cited tool output T4 explicitly reports no changes on the specified nodes and ancestors during the relevant time window.
